description: For every equality-free full scoped native formula \(A\), canonical world \((U,T)\), and actual assignment \(a\) of all free names and available slots into its term domain, \((U,T)\Vdash A[a]\) if and only if the complete ground instance of \(A\) at \(a\) belongs to \(T\). Primitive negation and future universal forcing are included.
